title: Why the Mercedes W123 never dies
body: Few cars earn the word legend. The W123, built from 1976 to 1986, did it by being very hard to wear out. Taxi drivers in many countries used them hard and still came back for more.
Its secret was simple engineering: strong bodies, honest engines and parts that were made to last. Many owners say a well-kept W123 is easier to live with than cars built decades later.
That is why you still see them today, from European streets to our own roads, and why collectors now look for clean examples.

title: Muscle cars in five minutes
body: A muscle car is simple: a mid-size body, a big V8 and a price ordinary people could manage. The Pontiac GTO of 1964 is often named as the car that started it all.
The Ford Mustang arrived the same year and created the pony car class, a smaller and more stylish cousin. Charger, Camaro and many others followed.
The golden age was short, but the sound and shape of these cars are still the picture most people have when they hear the words classic American car.
